data.name: Bahri
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'bahar' meaning 'sea', 'Bahri' denotes an abundance and richness, often associated with the bounties of nature, particularly the sea.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the richness and abundance of Allah's blessings in one's life.

in_arabic.name: بحري
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من البحر، يعني الكثير في البحر
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بحري مشتق من كلمة البحر، و يعني الشخص الذي يتصف بالاتساع و الكثرة، كما يوحي بالحركة و التنقل بين الأمكنة، و هو من الأسماء التي تذكر في القرآن الكريم لوصف بعض المعاني الروحانية و البحرية

in_urdu.name: بحری
in_urdu.meaning: بحر سے متعلق، وسیع اور گہرا
in_urdu.long_meaning: بحری نام کا مطلب ہے بحر سے متعلق، وسیع اور گہرا۔ یہ نام بحر کے عظیم وسعت اور گہرائی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر اسلامی تقالید میں روحانی اور معنوی معانی کے لئے بھی کیا گیا ہے

in_hindi.name: बहरी
in_hindi.meaning: समुद्र से संबंधित, विस्तृत और गहरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: बहरी नाम का अर्थ है समुद्र से संबंधित, विस्तृत और गहरा। यह नाम समुद्र की विशालता और गहराई को दर्शाता है, और इसका उल्लेख इस्लामी परंपरा में आध्यात्मिक और प्रतीकात्मक अर्थों के लिए भी किया गया है

in_pashto.name: بحري
in_pashto.meaning: د بحر اړوند، پراخ او ژور
in_pashto.long_meaning: بحري نوم د بحر څخه اخستل شوی دی، او د پراخوالي او ژورتیا معنی لري. دا نوم د بحر د لویوالي او ګنډوالی څرګندوي، او د افغاني او پښتني دودیزو ارزښتونو کې د روحاني او معنوي مفاهيمو لپاره کارول شوی دی

in_english.name: Bahri
in_english.meaning: relating to the sea, vast and deep
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bahri is derived from the Arabic word 'bahr', meaning sea or ocean. It signifies vastness, depth, and expansiveness. In Islamic tradition, the name Bahri is associated with spiritual and mystical connotations, referencing the boundless nature of the sea and its role in Quranic narratives

data.cultural_impact: The name "Bahri" has a rich and vibrant meaning in various Islamic cultural contexts. In the Middle Ages, Bahri referred to the early period of the Ayyubid Dynasty in Egypt, where the term was used to describe the prosperous and flourishing period in the history of Islamic art, architecture, and literature. This period was characterized by the blossoming of learning centers, refinement of artistic techniques, and the resultant development of a civilization steeped in beauty, excellence, and abundance.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Bahri" carries a deeper and more profound significance. It can be traced back to the Sufi tradition, where it gestures towards the inner journey of the soul towards the oceanic Reality, Allah, and the realization of one's true essence. During this spiritual odyssey, the seeker strives to gain insight into the divine unity and oneness, often symbolized by the vastness and depth of the sea. Ultimately, Bahri can be seen as a reminder of the boundless nature of the Divine and the infinite potential for spiritual growth for every individual.
